fieldData.description: Join RDX Works CMO Jeremy Epstein for an evening of Radix chat and amazing food and drink! The event will be held in a fantastic venue. You must leave your name and email address to gain entry. "Behind the lock is the Secret Garden - a magical courtyard with a secret bar lounge, a dance floor played by the best of DJ's, innovative cocktails, a specially designed menu and endless amounts of style."
